thag12.1:1.1: Ekādasanipāto niṭṭhito. DVĀDASANIPĀTO. Sīlam ev' idha sikkhetha asmiṃ loke susikkhitaṃ, sīlaṃ hi sabbasampattiṃ upanāmeti sevitaṃ. || ||
thag12.1:2.1: sīlaṃ rakkheyya medhāvī patthayāno tayo sukhe: pasaṃsaṃ vittilābhañ ca pecca sagge ca modanaṃ. || ||
thag12.1:3.1: sīlavā hi bahū mitte saññamenādhigacchati, dussīlo pana mittehi dhaṃsate pāpam ācaraṃ. || ||
thag12.1:4.1: avaṇṇañ ca akittiñ ca dussīlo labhate naro, vaṇṇaṃ kittiṃ pasaṃsañ ca sadā labhati sīlavā. || ||
thag12.1:5.1: ādi sīlaṃ patiṭṭhā ca kalyāṇānañ ca mātukaṃ pamukhaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, tasmā sīlaṃ visodhaye. || ||
thag12.1:6.1: velā ca saṃvaraṃ sīlaṃ cittassa abhibhāsanaṃ titthañ ca sabbabuddhānaṃ, tasmā sīlaṃ visodhaye. || ||
thag12.1:7.1: sīlaṃ balaṃ appaṭimaṃ, sīlaṃ āvudham uttamaṃ, sīlam ābharaṇaṃ seṭṭhaṃ, sīlaṃ kavacam abbhutaṃ. || ||
thag12.1:8.1: sīlaṃ setu mahesakkho, sīlaṃ gandho anuttaro, sīlaṃ vilepanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ yena vāti diso disaṃ. || ||
thag12.1:9.1: sīlaṃ sambalam ev' aggaṃ, sīlaṃ pātheyyam uttamaṃ, sīlaṃ seṭṭho ativāho yena yāti diso disaṃ. || ||
thag12.1:10.1: idh' eva nindaṃ labhati peccāpāye ca dummano, sabbattha dummano bālo sīlesu asamāhito. || ||
thag12.1:11.1: idh' eva kittiṃ labhati pecca sagge ca summano, sabbattha sumano dhīro sīlesu susamāhito. || ||
thag12.1:12.1: sīlam eva idha aggaṃ, paññavā pana uttamo; manussesu ca devesu sīlapaññāṇato jayan ti. || || Sīlavatthero.
